name: Rob Beckett
bio: Robert Anthony Beckett (born 2 January 1986) is an English comedian, actor, and television presenter. He is best known for co-hosting *I'm a Celebrity...Get Me Out of Here! NOW!*, serving as a team captain on *8 Out of 10 Cats* and *8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown*, narrating *Celebs Go Dating*, and presenting BBC One shows including *Wedding Day Winners* and *All Together Now*.
